newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ISRAEL, Dec 10 - Haifa - Six vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected. Loading/discharging at berth, 4 general cargo, 4 bulk, 3 containers, 1 tanker. No vessels discharging at anchorage. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 1 bulk, 2 containers. 1 Vessel under repair/drydock, 4 awaiting orders. Ashdod - Two to three days delay. Loading/discharging at berth, 7 general cargo, 2 bulk, 4 containers. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 3 general cargo, 1 bulk, 1 container vessel. Eilat - Vessels loading/discharging at berth, 1 container vessel, 1 passenger vessel.
JORDAN, Dec 7 - Aqaba - No vessels due, no delays expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 awaiting orders.

MOZAMBIQUE, Dec 9 - Nacala - Port working normally (first come, first served basis). no restriction on berthing and sailing during night time. Draft restriction of 9.5 metres plus height of tide at general cargo berths and 14 metres at container berth. One tug boat available. Beira - General cargo berths working normally (first come, first served basis). Container terminal/other terminals working normally. Pilotage is now possible 24 hours a day for vessels up to 140 metres loa with a maximum draft of 7.5 metres. Two tugboats now fully operational. Night navigation for larger vessels is restricted and subject to prior arrangements with the port captain.

Maputo - Pilotage is now possible 24 hours a day for vessels up to 120 metres loa with a maximum draft of 9 metres. Two tugboats available, one out of order. Night navigation for larger vessels is restricted and subject to prior arrangements with the port captain. All berths working normally and expected to remain so (first come, first served basis). Draft restriction in the channel is 9 metres less 0.5 metre plus rise of tide.
NAMIBIA, Dec 9 - Walvis Bay - Working normally.

SOUTH AFRICA, Dec 9 - Richards Bay - General cargo berths - working normally. Bulk import berths congested due to a fire in the port. Belts will be out from 10/12 to 1800 hours 14/12. Bulk export berths (minerals, etc.) - 1 Vessel due 10/12. Severe congestion expected from 15/12 onwards. Bulk coal berths - 4 Vessels alongside, 8 anchored, 15 due by 16/12. Berthing delays of 4-5 days currently. Durban - Container terminal - Delays of up to 48 hours currently. Point/New Pier/Maydon Wharf berths - Working normally for general cargo vessels. Maize terminal (Maydon Wharf 8) - No vessels due. Bunker supplies fluid. Delays of 8-10 hours in supplying of bunkers can be expected due to bunching of vessels. Drydock and floating dock - Booked for December and January.

East London - General cargo/combi terminal berths - Busy, but no delays expected. Drydock - Booked until end of January 1997. Copper moving in small parcels per month in containers to Far East. WHEAT imports - 1 Vessel due 17/12, 1 due on 22/12. Log loaders - 1 Vessel due end-December. Tankers are expected to be busy until end-December. Port Elizabeth - Three vessels in port, no delays expected on general, tanker, ore or container berths. Cape Town - No delays expected at breakbulk berths. Container terminal - Strong SE winds restricted the terminal to a total of approx. 24-36 hours workrom 5/12 todate. The terminal will commence working at 0930 hours on 9/12 after being wind bound since 1625 hours 8/12. Bunker berths - No delays. Drydock and repair quay - Fully occupied and booking essential. Saldanha Bay - Working normally.

TUNISIA, Dec 7 - Tunis - One vessel awaiting instructions, 1 general cargo, 1 discharging marble chips. Rades - Three ro/ro vessels in port. Goulette - North side - 1 General cargo vessel, 1 motor tanker discharging soyabean. South side - 1 Vessel discharging grain. One vessel in roads. Sfax - Four vessels operating in port of which 1 each discharging general cargo, timber, containers, 1 loading salt. Sousse - One vessel discharging paper reels, no waiting time. No vessels awaiting orders. Dec 10 - Bizerta - One vessel discharging sugar, 1 other vessel, no delays/congestion. Zarzis - No vessels, no delays.

UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, Dec 8 - Dubai - Vessels operating in port from 1/12 to 7/12, 68 container vessels, 10 general cargo, 1 bulk carrier, 3 car carriers, 19 tankers, 6 naval vessels, 2 UAE naval vessels, 1 livestock carrier, 4 dhows, 11 barges, 15 supply boats, 1 each lpg tanker, passenger vessel, fishing trawler, vlcc, chemical tanker, heavy lift, crane barge. 30 vessels due of which 14 general cargo, 5 tankers, 6 general cargo discharging at berth. 3 Tankers discharging at berth, 1 general cargo waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 general cargo under repair, 6 tankers laid up.

YEMEN, Dec 8 - Hodeidah - Vessels alongside, 1 each bulk wheat, sugar, wheat flour, timber, urea, containers, containers/general cargo. No vessels anchored. Berthing waiting time, general cargo up to 2 days, bagged cargo up to 4 days, bulk cargo up to 6 days, containers up to 1 day. Mokha - One vessel discharging wheat flour alongside. No vessels anchored, no berthing waiting time.
